description: Fetch one memory by key: full text, tags and provenance. A split memory comes back whole whichever piece you ask for (`chunk_keys` lists the pieces; `piece_only: true` returns just the one). `truncated: true` means the text was cut at 64 KB. Unlike `recall`, this reaches pending, superseded and deleted objects. Cite `source_uri` for a "connector" source. `edges: true` adds links; `history: true` walks the `supersedes` chain.

edges.description: Include this object's edges (both directions) in the response.

key.description: The key to look up, as returned by `remember` or `recall`.

piece_only.description: When true and the key is one piece of a long memory, return only that piece.

name: expand
title: Fetch one memory in full
